meta.promptText: I want to buy running shoes under ₹3000 in India. Which ones should I get?

response.text:

My recommendation depends on whether you're running on roads, using a treadmill, or mixing running with everyday walking. At this price, sale discounts can make a big difference, so it’s worth comparing a few models before buying.
